notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment marked the italic 'goeth' added under rule 34. But rule 34's supplied-lexical-verb clause governs a line whose predicate the Hebrew leaves unwritten altogether, as its 'cheweth' does; here לִפְנֵי כָבוֹד is a written prepositional predicate and 'goeth' merely links עֲנָוָה to it, adding no participant, which is rule 20's expanded copula and rule 49's placement of it on the preposition.
The verb of the first colon is יִגְבַּהּ, rendered 'is haughty', so 'goeth' is not a second realization of a written verb under rule 34's pro-verb sentence either.
